description.value: Gary's Kitchen is a sit-down restaurant in Tofino serving a Chinese-American fusion menu. It offers takeout as well as dine-in, making it a practical stop for touring cyclists who need a hot meal to go. Tofino's remote location on the west coast of Vancouver Island means options are limited, and a full-service restaurant covering two cuisines is a useful find after a long day on the road.

address.value: 308 Neill St, Tofino, BC V0R 3A0, Canada
